segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the cleanser as gentle and non-stripping, and in some cases hydrating, though a couple mention slight tightness or dryness right after rinsing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-oily skin generally found the cleanser balanced and effective at cleansing without over-drying, though a few note mild tightness afterward.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or reactive report no irritation or breakouts, but a handful describe strong allergic-type reactions with redness and burning.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who specifies normal skin reports the cleanser left the face feeling oily afterward along with a few pimples and redness.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the cleanser can leave skin feeling tight or slightly dry right after rinsing, though many others, including some with dry skin, report no dryness at all and describe it as hydrating.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers developed facial redness after use, in one case alongside burning, while others with sensitive skin specifically report no redness or irritation.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers describe an allergic-type reaction that led to an ongoing breakout, but several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some note fewer blemishes with continued use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer said the cleanser removed surface oil but did not reduce the underlying oiliness, even though it helped soothe her acne irritation at the same time.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way
Can leave skin feeling tight after rinsing

extraits.texte: I tried the Mac cosmetics FOAMO gel cleanser, and had an allergic reaction. My skin is typically not sensitive at all, so I was surprised to see my skin after using this cleanser. My face felt amazing while removing makeup and cleansing. I felt an awesome "cooling" sensation that felt amazing while cleansing, until my face started turning beat red and burning. It really surprised me as I usually don't react to much when it comes to what I put on my face. I like the texture of the cleanser and the packaging, but I'm afraid to use it again due to the reaction I got from trying it. I really wish it didn't cause a reaction as I like everything else about the product. It removes makeup extremely well along with dirt and oil. I just can't handle the aftermath. I still love you Mac cosmetics! "I received this from Mac cosmetics in exchange for my honest review"

It comes in a nice plastic squeeze tube with a small rubber on the opening that controls how the product comes out, so it doesn't just ooze. The gel is clear and foams well. I usually use it to remove long-wearing makeup and it cleans really well. I have combination-oily skin, so it works for me, but it can be a little drying. My skin feels smooth but a little tight after I use it. The herbal scent is okay, but I prefer unscented, especially if it's not a natural scent. It rinses easily and is simple to use. My other concern is the ingredients. I would have preferred no fragrance and a more natural preservative instead of phenoxyethanol. Overall, it's a good cleansing gel, but maybe not for sensitive or dry skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This jelly cleanser is fun! A little goes a LONG way. I squeeze less than a pea size out at a time and get fulll coverage when lathering up my face. It doesnt have any heavy type of exfoliant in it that I've noticed, and the surfactant is very mild in this formula, so it's felt very smooth and gentle on my sensitive and reaction skin. The scent is cucumbers but it's not cloyingly strong and fades quickly so I'm alright with it. I use it in the mornings in the shower and follow it with a moisturizer and dewy drops after and after about 3 weeks of use my skin still looks great and I haven't had any break outs. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser is great for those who wear makeup or have dry skin. I like it how it was gentle on my skin and it "soothe" the irritation from my acne. My only complain is that it didn't help with the oiliness, it only helped remove anything that was on the surface of the skin, in my case it was sunscreen. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I really liked this cleanser. I have combination skin with some points being very oily and some very dry. I've used other foaming gel cleansers in the past, which have worked well on my skin, and this worked just as well. It removes makeup/oil cleanser, oil, and grime from my face without leaving me feeling stripped and dry. It has a pleasant, gentle smell as well that's a little similar to herbal skincare products. My skin reacted really well to this and I didn't experience any issues with it. I'm looking forward to using the rest. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This face wash worked shockingly well for me, I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin, so I'm always hesitant about using a new product. This cleansed my face well without drying, didn't cause any redness or irritation, and didn't trigger my acne. It seemed like a may be been a bit buffing, maybe there's a gentle exfoliant in there? It did leave my skin matte, but not dry, so if you're looking for a dewy look this may not be for you. For me though, its great. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I have dry skin and usually use only a preferred set of cleansers that does not rip off oils from skin. This foam cleanser from Mac is very gentle on my skin and keeps my skin hydrated and plumped. Also did well during winters and windy climate
